name: course-to-shorts
description: Turn a course link into complete LaTeX study notes and narrated 3Blue1Brown-style explainer shorts.

interface.shortDescription: Course link to study notes and explainer reels
interface.longDescription: Ingest a course (MIT OpenCourseWare or any course site, PDFs, folders), plan a beginner-safe series of shorts with verified worked examples, write and compile complete LaTeX study notes, and storyboard, narrate, render and visually review vertical Manim explainers ready for Instagram Reels.
defaultPrompt: Turn https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-06sc-linear-algebra-fall-2011/ into study notes and five explainer shorts.
Make a narrated explainer short showing why eigenvectors keep their direction.
Where does my course run stand, and is it ready to publish?
